name: ok
description: Approve the current review candidate for ONE relation. If a proposed repair exists, ok accepts that exact merge/split/edit/delete/placeholder proposal; otherwise it confirms the original alignment relation without inventing a repair action. Do not use on relations containing ⟢MISSING⟣ (use edit instead).

name: edit
description: Replace original text of one side or both sides of one or more CONSECUTIVE relations. Operates on INITIAL text. Pass only the side(s) needing change; for a single relation you may pass one side only. If both new_src and new_tgt are passed, their arrays must have equal length (each row pair becomes a 1:1 relation).

new_src.description: New source lines — one per relation in the range. Omit to keep source unchanged.

new_tgt.description: New target lines — one per relation in the range. Omit to keep target unchanged.

name: merge
description: Merge consecutive relations into a single 1:1 relation: source lines join into one paragraph, target lines join into one paragraph. Both sides merge simultaneously. Do NOT merge when each source line is a complete, independent sentence — use ok instead for clean N:N splits.

target.description: Relation ordinal (e.g. '7') or consecutive range to merge (e.g. '10-13').

name: delete
description: Remove one or more relations entirely (both sides). Use only for content that is clearly redundant or a duplicate of another relation. If content belongs to a neighbor, re-assign it with edit instead of deleting it.

name: flag
description: Mark ONE relation for human review because you cannot resolve it reliably. Provide a note explaining the difficulty.

name: view
description: Retrieve full JSON content of specified relations (initial and current text). Use when the ±3 context is insufficient.

target.description: Comma-separated relation ordinals or ranges, e.g. '1-3,5,11'.

name: append
description: Add a relation you discovered as problematic (outside the flagged list) to the review list so it is processed this round. Only use when you cannot resolve it immediately with edit/merge/delete.

name: done
description: Finish the review. Only valid when ALL flagged relations have been processed (ok/edit/merge/delete/flag). Call it after your last action in the same response, or in the following turn. If you have a legitimate reason to skip remaining items (e.g. systemic duplicates already handled), set force=true and explain in note.

force.description: Set true to finish even if some flagged relations remain unprocessed. Requires a note explaining why.
